prompt: 用户投诉我们的外卖 App 订单列表页：1) 弱网时转圈很久，最后显示“暂无订单”，但用户其实有历史订单；2) iOS 大字体模式下，底部固定的“再来一单”按钮把最后一个订单的金额挡住了。分析问题原因并给出修复方案。
assertions: Distinguishes request-failed/timeout from genuinely empty order data as the root-cause class of problem 1
Proposes offline/cache honesty: cached orders shown with freshness or sync labeling instead of a bare 暂无订单
Identifies fixed layout / missing runtime safe-area or inset handling as the cause of problem 2, with an inset-aware or scrollable fix
Addresses large-text scaling via text roles and adaptive layout rather than by shrinking or fixing text size
Each fix carries a verification/retest method (e.g. airplane mode, slow network simulation, largest accessibility text size)
Assigns severity or priority per issue, and does not claim unverified fixes as verified
